frozen.target_load_source: review load of the simple sensitive-area policy on the 2024 development cohort (324/891)
frozen.theta_rule: deterministic soft-score threshold whose 2024 load is closest to the target (0.325; theta 2 gave 0.404)
frozen.tau_rule: model risk threshold whose estimated 2024 load is closest to the target (0.356), estimated on a seeded random sample of 150 of the 696 development PRs the model would read (seed 20260926)
frozen.invocation: claude -p --model sonnet --tools '' --setting-sources '' --strict-mcp-config --mcp-config '{"mcpServers":{}}' --disable-slash-commands --no-session-persistence --system-prompt <fixed> --output-format json, from an empty temporary directory
frozen.what_was_known_when: Thresholds theta and tau were chosen on 2024 data only. Before the freeze commit, the 2025 labels had already been adjudicated (oracle/labels.json, 10:35) and the list of 2025 PRs the model would read had been computed from the deterministic signals (10:50); signals.py was last edited at 10:53 (a path-based persistence signal, chosen from 2024 misses). No 2025 policy decision and no 2025 model answer existed before the commit: the first 2025 model answer is timestamped 10:55:33, the 2025 scoring ran at 11:02. The rule author had read the titles of the 2025 labelled PRs before writing the rules.
frozen.check_against_overfitting_2025: On 2024 the deterministic policy passed 7 of 28 confirmed failures at 32.5% load (random routing: 18.9); the path list 8 of 28 at 36.4% (random: 17.8). On 2025 both fall to chance level, which is not what rules tuned on 2025 would do.

labelled.label: A
labelled.title: Encode analytics ids in script
hybrid_reasons: model risk 4/5: The empty/whitespace check on PixelId/TrackingID/ContainerID was dropped (now only checks settings is not null), so sites that never configured Facebook Pixel/Google Analytics/Tag Manager will start unconditionally emitting broken tracking scripts (e.g. fbq('init','')) on every page across all tenants using these modules.
deterministic_reasons: +1 no test changed alongside production change

labelled.label: A
labelled.title: fix taxonomy field multiselect mode tags automatic sorting problem
hybrid_reasons: model risk 4/5: Changing the iteration to only walk field.TermContentItemIds instead of all contentItems could break the full taxonomy tree/checkbox rendering used by the multiselect editor, since unselected terms (and their children) would no longer be added to termEntries at any level.

labelled.label: A
labelled.title: Add "save and continue" button to admin menu node and content type editors
hybrid_reasons: model risk 3/5: The ContentTypes AdminController.Edit action's control flow and the renamed submit button field are altered so that normal Save/SaveAndContinue handling changes for the core content-type editing screen without a visible persistence call in the shown diff, risking a regression in this widely-used admin CRUD workflow.

labelled.label: B
labelled.title: Add condition for User moderation and Email confirmation upon registration
hybrid_reasons: model risk 3/5: This changes authentication behavior on registration (skipping auto sign-in when moderation or email confirmation is required), which is security-sensitive and could affect existing sites relying on current sign-in-after-registration behavior even when those options are misconfigured or interact with custom registration flows.

labelled.label: A
labelled.title: Add opacity option for the text color field
hybrid_reasons: model risk 3/5: Hardcoded static element IDs (color, color_wrapper, color_opacity) will collide if multiple Color text fields appear on the same edit screen, and the new alpha-suffixed hex value format (#RRGGBBAA) could break themes/templates or validation patterns that expect a plain 6-digit hex color.
deterministic_reasons: +1 no test changed alongside production change

labelled.label: A
labelled.title: Add missing useCdn in ScriptBlock
hybrid_reasons: model risk 4/5: The new "useCdn" case incorrectly assigns to the 'name' variable instead of a useCdn field (which doesn't even appear to exist), meaning this bug-fix PR doesn't actually add useCdn support and will silently corrupt the script name when that attribute is used.
